issues.description: conandata.yml manually adds gh-proxy mirror prefix as the first URL entry for the 'task' source. Rule R39 explicitly states: 'CI 会自动为 GitHub URL 添加镜像 fallback（gh-proxy/ghproxy/gitclone/moeyy/kkgithub），因此 conandata.yml 中只需写官方原始 URL，不要手动加镜像前缀。' The gh-proxy URL should not be in conandata.yml; CI handles mirror fallback automatically.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the gh-proxy prefixed URL line. Keep only the official GitHub URL: "https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/taskwarrior/archive/refs/tags/v2.6.2.tar.gz". CI will automatically add mirror fallbacks during build.

issues.description: Same R39 violation for the 'libshared' source — manually added gh-proxy mirror prefix as first URL entry. The rule requires only official URLs in conandata.yml without manual mirror prefixes.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the gh-proxy prefixed URL line. Keep only the official GitHub URL: "https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/libshared/archive/072e0e0cb91c1e05e02db59ed83924b43e992938.tar.gz".

issues.description: manifest.yaml uses 'software:' as the field name instead of 'name:' as specified in code style rule section 14. The standard template shows 'name: zlib', not 'software: zlib'. This field name deviation from the code style standard.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'software: task' to 'name: task' to match the code style standard for manifest.yaml.

issues.description: manifest.yaml version field '2.6.2' is not quoted. Code style rule section 14 shows version with double quotes: version: "1.3.1". YAML string values should be quoted per the project's YAML conventions (section 13: '字符串值带双引号').

conanfile.py has 'url = ""' (empty recipe repository URL). While it does not contain the prohibited '# CI fills this' comment, an empty url field provides no value and resembles an unfinished placeholder. In Conan, 'url' refers to the recipe's own repository URL.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either set url to the recipe repository URL (e.g., the openharmony-compile-agent repo) or remove the 'url' attribute entirely if not applicable.

issues.description: Environment variables TASKDATA and TASKRC are set via os.environ (lines 33-34) but cleaned up with 'del' statements (lines 44-45) outside a try/finally block. If any self.run() call raises an exception (test failure), the 'del' lines will not execute, leaving environment variables leaked to subsequent test runs.
issues.fix_suggestion: Wrap the env var usage in a try/finally block to ensure cleanup, or pass environment variables directly to self.run() via the env parameter instead of modifying os.environ globally.

issues.description: Only the first self.run() call (line 23) uses env="conanrun", but subsequent self.run() calls for 'add', 'list', and 'done' commands (lines 36, 38, 40, 42) do not. If the binary has runtime shared library dependencies, the subsequent calls may fail due to missing library paths from the VirtualRunEnv generator.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add env="conanrun" to all self.run() calls for consistency, or document why subsequent calls don't need the conan runtime environment (e.g., if all deps are statically linked).

issues.description: Comment 'Remove libtool files' is misleading — the code uses rmdir() to remove the entire 'lib' directory, not just .la libtool files. For an application (package_type='application'), removing the lib directory is correct since no libraries are exported, but the comment should accurately describe the action.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update comment to 'Remove lib directory (application does not export libraries)' or similar accurate description.

summary:
Audit of task 2.6.2 (Taskwarrior) Conan recipe PR on branch feat/task-2.6.2. No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found.

Section 1 (Deception Detection — highest priority): ALL PASS. R34: test_package genuinely exercises the binary — runs 'task --version', 'task add', 'task list', 'task 1 done' workflow (not an empty shell test). R9: no skipped/faked tests. sha256 values are real 64-char hex strings (task: 779ff60d..., libshared: ca956132...). manifest.yaml status 'built' is consistent with notes.md. No pre-compiled binaries (R19). No #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs. Taskwarrior is a CLI tool not in R40 deep-adaptation categories.

Section 2 (Recipe Quality): R32 PASS — OS check uses 'not in ("Linux", "OHOS")' pattern. R33 PASS — build() has no os.environ usage. R38 PASS — commands.json exists at archives/t/task/commands.json with type='tool', name='task'. Conan 2.x API used correctly (from conan import ConanFile, conan.tools.cmake). R39 PARTIAL FAIL — URLs point to official GothenburgBitFactory GitHub repos, but conandata.yml manually adds gh-proxy mirror prefix (P2). uuid dependency is linked as libuuid.a (static), satisfying R26.

Section 3 (File Standards): Archive directory structure correct (conanfile.py, conandata.yml, test_package/, manifest.yaml, notes.md under archives/t/task/2.6.2/; commands.json at software level). No prohibited files (.build-context-*, *.log, .DS_Store, pre-compiled binaries). 3 junk files from other packages being deleted (conandata.yml.orig, conandata.yml.ghfast-bak, .staging-verified) — appropriate cleanup.

Code Style: Method order correct (validate→export_sources→requirements→layout→source→generate→build→package→package_info). Import order correct (stdlib→conan with blank line). Class name PascalCase (TaskConan). package_type='application' correct. package_info sets bindirs=['bin'] (correct for application). conandata.yml uses 2-space indent, quoted strings, HTTPS URLs. commands.json well-formed.

Issues found: 4 P2 (conandata.yml has manually-added gh-proxy mirror prefixes for both sources — R39; manifest.yaml uses 'software' instead of 'name' field and unquoted version — code_style §14), 4 P3 (empty url field in conanfile.py; test_package env var cleanup not in try/finally; inconsistent conanrun env usage in test_package; misleading 'libtool files' comment). Verdict: PASS with warnings — P2 issues should be fixed before merge but are not blocking.
